message: No detected input validation: The code performs minimal filtering (checking for matched patient IDs and valid status strings) but does no structural, dtype, or range validation on the loaded pickle graphs or CSV data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only (./CLINI.csv and ./graphs); no remote sources are used and no integrity checks (checksums, signatures) are performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only filters labels to 'Positive' or 'Negative' values but performs no anomaly detection, distribution comparison, or label-noise checking to detect flipped labels.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code applies standard normalization (mean/std) but includes no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious graph samples to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads graph data via pickle.load() without any hash or signature verification, and the GNN model is constructed from scratch rather than loaded from a pretrained checkpoint, so no model integrity verification is performed.

No detected label distribution validation: The code filters labels to only 'Positive'/'Negative' but performs no explicit class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-testing in the evaluation code.

No detected input sanitization: The code loads graphs directly from pickle files and filters only by patient ID match and receptor status string values, but performs no shape, range, or schema validation on the graph node features before passing them to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are passed directly to metric functions (roc_auc_score, average_precision_score) and Platt scaling without any NaN guards, probability range checks, or sanity bound validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a graph neural network model for pathology classification, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
